items.title: ENA unlock: 93,750,000 ENA (0.625% of supply) · Core contributors (30% of supply) + amount not published · Investors
items.summary: The page puts core contributors at 30% of ENA, locked on a one-year cliff at which 25% unlocks, then vesting monthly over three years, with schedules starting at the March 5, 2024 TGE. So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.

So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.

items.title: MORPHO: Founders (15.2% of supply): vesting ends; Strategic partners, cohort 3: vesting ends
items.summary: The docs say all co-founders relocked to a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from the earlier of the transferability date (November 21, 2024) or May 17, 2025. The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028. The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. The two official figures disagree, so no amount is shown.

headlines.title: Stablecoin Market Shrinks About $17 Billion in 30 Days
headlines.summary: DefiLlama's dashboard shows a 5.73% contraction, with USDT, USDC and Sky's USDS among the major stablecoins shrinking.

headlines.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
headlines.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

headlines.title: Kraken’s Krak Plans US Credit Cards With USDC Option
headlines.summary: The top 4% cashback tier requires a $150,000 Krak balance and Krakpass membership. The secured card will lock USDC while earning variable yield.

headlines.title: What the CFTC’s New Crypto Reserves Guidance Actually Allows—And What It Doesn’t
headlines.summary: Staff guidance lets swap venues and clearinghouses count Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins toward their 12-month operating-cost buffer. Here's the catch.

headlines.title: Ledn Moves US Business Onshore, Adds BitGo Custody
headlines.summary: The account adds bank-funded bitcoin purchases executed by BitGo. Trading and lending are subject to state eligibility.

headlines.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
headlines.summary: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.

headlines.title: We’ve Entered Peak FEAR; SKY Falls
headlines.summary: Fear no Greed Last week was another down week, with Bitcoin now retracing its entire summer move. The Fear and Greed Index continued its downward trend, nearly dropping to single digits. Bitcoin’s price hit a local high of $87k after…

headlines.title: Fed Governor Waller warns of "zombie chains" as tokenization grows
headlines.summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller warned that tokenized assets could be stranded on failed blockchains and called for clearer governance.

headlines.title: CFTC approves Backpack to run derivatives exchange and clearinghouse
headlines.summary: The CFTC approved Backpack’s US exchange and clearinghouse, paving the way for leveraged crypto perpetual futures and global liquidity.

headlines.title: Fidelity Crypto Adds AAVE, LINK and UNI to Its Lineup
headlines.summary: Eligible customers can trade the tokens in individual, joint and crypto IRA accounts, with Oregon excluded and a 1% fee on buys and sells.

headlines.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sells $43.8 million in ETH to cut Aave debt, CEO says ‘we do not take this lightly’
headlines.summary: Nasdaq-listed BTCS sold 27,300 ETH during Friday's crypto rout to slash decentralized debt and curb collateral liquidation risk.

headlines.title: Crypto Market Structure Basics
headlines.summary: Crypto Market Structure 101 explains how crypto markets work for beginners. It covers centralized and decentralized exchanges, trading pairs and settlement, order types, leverage and perpetual futures, market makers, key market players,…

headlines.title: Deel Launches Stablecoin Spending Card in 26 Markets
headlines.summary: The Stripe-powered Visa card lets eligible contractors spend DLUSD balances without first moving funds to a bank. Employee access is coming soon.

headlines.title: Aave Horizon Adds HINC High-Yield Fund as Collateral
headlines.summary: Eligible holders can borrow USDC, GHO and RLUSD without redeeming the fund, with standard initial borrowing capped at 55% of collateral value.

headlines.title: XRP Ledger DEX volume hits 4.51 million XRP a day in Q3 as big traders take over: Evernorth
headlines.summary: XRP Ledger DEX order-book volume averaged 4.51M XRP a day in Q3, Evernorth says, as top accounts drove 65% of trading and RLUSD rose 74%.

headlines.title: Ledn brings US business onshore with account to hold, swap and borrow against bitcoin
headlines.summary: Ledn's new U.S. custody account lets customers hold bitcoin, gold, stablecoins and dollars, swap with no trading fees and borrow against bitcoin without selling.

headlines.title: Neuberger Berman’s HINC fund brings high-yield credit to Aave’s institutional lending platform
headlines.summary: Neuberger Berman's tokenized high-yield fund HINC launches on Aave Horizon, letting eligible investors borrow USDC, GHO and RLUSD against it.

headlines.title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
headlines.summary: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.

headlines.title: Sky lender proposes buyback of up to $50M to fund stUSDS withdrawals
headlines.summary: Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol and use the proceeds to pay down their loans, freeing up funds for depositors in the stUSDS pool.

headlines.title: OKX Australia Opens Stock and Commodity Perps to Retail
headlines.summary: The expansion brings round-the-clock exposure to stocks and commodities under a 2x leverage cap, without ownership of the underlying assets.

headlines.title: Sun-Linked Wallet Moves $1.49 Billion From Sky to Aave
headlines.summary: Ethereum transactions trace a concentrated exit from Sky savings and a rewards farm into Aave, as Spark unwound lending positions to replenish Sky's exchange reserve.

headlines.title: BlackRock opens tokenized money market fund with $100 million in assets to Hong Kong investors
headlines.summary: BlackRock has launched and opened its HKD Digital Liquidity Fund to retail and institutional investors in Hong Kong.

headlines.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
headlines.summary: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

headlines.title: BTCS sells more than half its ether to repay $43.8 million in Aave debt
headlines.summary: The firm's DeFi business, Imperium, temporarily pulled out of liquidity pools after generating $3.5 million in Q3 revenue.

headlines.title: South Korea regulator backs bank-controlled stablecoins after months of dispute
headlines.summary: Fintech firms could lead stablecoin ventures, but banks would need to own more than half of any issuer.

headlines.title: South Korea Proposes ICO Return, Exchange Ownership Cap
headlines.summary: The FSC would initially limit domestic issuance of won-pegged stablecoins to bank-majority consortia. Its proposed 20% exchange ownership cap allows exceptions.

headlines.title: BlackRock Opens Hong Kong Fund to Stablecoin Payments
headlines.summary: The HKD Digital Liquidity Fund offers tokenized units from HK$10, but its stablecoin payment route is for professional investors.

headlines.title: Lighter Bridge TVL Falls 14.4% as USDC Balance Shrinks
headlines.summary: DefiLlama recorded 82.8 million fewer USDC tokens over Nov. 15–22. Aster Bridge, one selected comparator, posted a smaller 3.6% TVL decline.

headlines.title: Yield Basis Activates propAMM on Active Bitcoin Pools
headlines.summary: Existing WBTC, cbBTC and tBTC positions need no migration, the protocol says. Qualifying trades can pay less than the policy's 2% fallback fee.

headlines.title: Samsung Wallet USDC Sends on Sui Go Live, Sui Says
headlines.summary: The rollout adds a network option to Samsung's existing stablecoin account. New York residents are excluded, and identity checks are required.
